title: Final Answer for M_s
description: Essential Criteria: The correct final answer for M_s must be provided as M_s = 0.

title: Correct Use of Variables
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define and use N, N_uparrow, and N_downarrow in their calculations.

title: Number of States Expression
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for the number of states Q accurately.

title: Stirling's Approximation
description: Important Criteria: The application of Stirling's formula in the context of the problem must be correctly shown.

title: Understanding of Negative Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The definition and explanation of negative absolute temperature must be clearly articulated.

title: Example of Negative Temperature
description: Important Criteria: A concrete example demonstrating negative absolute temperature must be provided.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Any sign mistakes or incorrect assumptions about the number of states must be avoided.

title: Units and Definitions
description: Optional Criteria: Proper units and definitions related to spin and temperature should be included.
